headline: Texans RB Montgomery, S Pitre out for London affair vs. Jaguars
summary: Texans starting RB David Montgomery (groin) and safety Jalen Pitre (shoulder) have been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Jaguars in London.

headline: Bears QB Williams unsure if he's playing, has to still go through protocols
summary: Caleb Williams reached another milestone in his recovery from a hamstring injury, logging full participation in practice for the first time since Sept. 18.

headline: Jayden Daniels addresses teammates on gaffe, vows 'it'll never happen again'
summary: Jayden Daniels addressed his Commanders teammates, once more blaming himself for the end-of-overtime debacle against the Giants and vowing it won't happen again.

headline: Troy Aikman: It seems like ESPN is going to go in a different direction
summary: Hall of Fame quarterback and ESPN/ABC Monday Night Football analyst Troy Aikman made some waves on Thursday morning by creating the clear impression that he's planning to leave after his current contract expires, after Super Bowl LXI.

headline: Panthers to visit an Eagles team that was already reeling before losing Hurts to a blood clot
summary: — The Carolina Panthers had already been installed as road betting favorites as they prepare to visit Philadelphia and face a banged-up Eagles team riding a three-game losing streak.
